terms.canonical_expansion: the fast-paced world of machine learning
terms.context: Welcome to Machine Learning Systems, your gateway to the fast-paced world of machine learning (ML) systems. This two-volume work is an extension of the [CS249r](https://sites.google.com/g.harvard.edu/cs249-tinyml-2023) course at Harvard University, expanding from TinyML to broader ML systems topics, taught by Prof. Vijay Janapa Reddi, and is the result of a collaborative effort involving students, professionals, and the broader community of AI practitioners.
